firstLaunch.license.htdemucsNotice: HTDemucs weights: maintainer adefossez wrote on 23 May 2022 (Demucs #327) that the weights “are not covered by the MIT license, and are provided only for scientific purposes”. Read on 2026-09-29. The audio.cpp card says “MIT, commercial use: yes” but no upstream source confirms it; that mention must not be read as the weight license. audio.cpp v0.8.2 code is Apache-2.0 (weights keep their original license).

firstLaunch.noGpu.alertBody: Music generation needs an NVIDIA graphics card (Windows or Linux) or an Apple chip with Metal (Mac). Without it, the YuE2 model cannot run — that is why we do not download it.

firstLaunch.noGpu.opt1.body: A missing or outdated driver is the most common cause. After installing, run detection again.
